summary: Davao City 1st District representative with 45 principal-authored bills. Authored a VAT social transfer for indigents, a tourist VAT refund and an oil price stabilization fund that would repeal oil deregulation. Filed resolutions for an inquiry into alleged budget insertions and rejecting charter change through a constituent assembly.
caveat: Democratic score rests on two resolutions, not laws. Scores do not weigh political alignment or family ties.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored VAT social transfer for indigents (-3) and an oil price stabilization fund repealing deregulation (-3), against a point-of-sale VAT refund for tourists (+1).
